method: read new producer functions from STATISTICAL_FIELDS
read candidate metadata and test_rite source
no tests, PE, remote providers, emenda registration, source modification or E2_PRIVATE

verified_by_inspection.point: run_rite admits only historical E7 posterior SHA from pinned receipt, calibration-only plan, and returns AWAITING_DATA with physical lnB/z null and no heavy/blind authorization.
Four legacy formula ASTs are tested for equality by test_rite; verification here is static source inspection, not an independent execution of that test.
Source and tar files present are SHA checked; absent files are labeled DECLARADO_NOT_VERIFIED_HERE and add a red-gate reason.
Conditional E0 targets are copied from registered planning_targets with CONDITIONAL_PLANNING_ONLY label; test_count uses blind_test role, not calibration-event count.

findings.title: Registered E7 code identity incompletely checked by embedded_context
findings.evidence: Only __file__ is hashed against producer_tree_sha256[tgl_ringdown_ampliacao.py]. The function does not require e7.producer_directory to equal the new producer path, e7.guard_path to equal the embedded consumer, guard_sha256 to match it, or verify the other tree entry. A witnessed candidate with these metadata fields inconsistent can still pass this read-only consumer.
findings.action: Require exact registered path identities and hash equality for the files actually used; if the two-file tree is claimed complete, verify its registered file set without accepting mere directory existence. Preserve no external importlib.

findings.title: Malformed V1.1 amendment filename is silently ignored
findings.evidence: The later-link search filters malformed names instead of rejecting them. A file matching RINGDOWN_5SIGMA_V1_1_*.json with an invalid ordinal such as _02.json is ignored here, whereas registration_guard.numbered_chain rejects malformed chain names. The read-only consumer and launch guard can disagree about chain validity.
findings.action: Reject every globbed chain member that does not match the canonical numbered pattern; also reject a gap or duplicate ordinal explicitly.

findings.title: Transported 440 rows lack local scope binding
findings.evidence: The T05 receipt SHA is pinned, but all rows with mode==440 are returned without checking receipt status, event identity against the intended single nonblind calibration event, or expected row schema. The label says single-event/nonblind solely from local text.
findings.action: Validate T05 status, event/role and row schema before carrying its 440 rows; otherwise mark the transport as DECLARADO/OPEN with the receipt pin and no event association.

findings.title: Historical authorization field in amendment is not bound to used receipt pin
findings.evidence: run_rite takes authorization SHA from the E7 execution receipt and checks the file at candidate e7_rite_v1_1.legacy_authorization_path, but never compares that SHA to e7_rite_v1_1.legacy_authorization_sha256. This is metadata inconsistency rather than an execution bypass because the receipt still pins the used bytes.
findings.action: Require candidate declared historical authorization SHA == receipt.authorization_sha256 and check its canonical path.

prepublication_limit: CANDIDATE_V1_1_1.json is still a candidate, not a witnessed/published sub-amendment. No real T12 rite execution or physical verification was observed.
